title: Al-Aziz: The Divine Name That Is Also an Egyptian Job Title — and Who Ends Up Holding It
excerpt: The word occurs 101 times. Four are in Surah Yusuf, where it is an office — and by the end of the surah the title has passed from the man who bought Yusuf to Yusuf himself.
seo_title: Al-Aziz: Meaning of the Divine Name in the Quran
seo_description: Al-Aziz appears 101 times in the Quran and 47 of those attach al-Hakim, the Wise. In Surah Yusuf it is a human office — and the title changes hands.
